# Explanation evaluation fixtures

`candidate_cases.jsonl` is generated by `scripts/build_ai_eval_candidates.py`: 160 **unreviewed** synthetic cases, 30 structural adversarial probes, and eight ineligible cases. Five substitutions must fail before provider submission; the other output probes test local validation and do not establish model resistance. Do not flip `reviewed` without independent IAM review and a frozen record.

Approved `cases.jsonl` records need unique `case_id`, dataset, eligibility, eight critical strata where applicable, pinned review/snapshot/observation/assessment and manifest references, context/input hash, allowed citations, expected claims/limitations, forbidden implications, privacy sentinels, selection method, and review/data-approval status. Ineligible cases have no provider output. `outputs.jsonl` holds exact worker JSON and per-call model/region/version/approval/input/usage metadata; the separate run manifest binds commit and full fixture hash. `grades.jsonl` holds two distinct IAM reviewer IDs and booleans for groundedness, limitations, citation completeness, and severe failure; preserve raw grades before adjudication. The reviewer study is a separate human record.

Historical evidence and outputs stay outside Git under approved access and retention controls. The guarded runner needs `--execute`; the offline screen remains blocked until reviewed cases, approved historical inputs, real outputs, independent grades, and an adjudicated study exist. See [AI governance](../../../docs/ai-governance.md).
